assertions.subject: Intra-abdominal Abscess
assertions.quote: For abscesses above the pelvis, the diagnosis will depend on radiologic confirmation.

assertions.subject: Intra-abdominal Abscess
assertions.quote: Ultrasonography can occasionally delineate ﬂuid collections in the upper abdomen and in the pelvis.

assertions.subject: Intra-abdominal Abscess
assertions.quote: Computed tomography scanning is more sensitive and specific for diagnosing intra-abdominal abscesses and often is the radiologic procedure of choice.

assertions.subject: Intra-abdominal Abscess
assertions.quote: Occasionally, if conventional radiologic methods fail to identify an abscess and the index of suspicion for an abscess remains high, labeled leukocyte scanning may be useful for locating the infected focus.

assertions.subject: Intra-abdominal Abscess
assertions.quote: Standard therapy for intra-abdominal abscess is evacuation and drainage combined with appropriate parenteral administration of antibiotics.

assertions.subject: Intra-abdominal Abscess
